_about: Real plan_check replies for the made-up sample couple, written by scripts in the engine repo run against the engine commit below. Regenerate, never edit by hand.

ask.question: How old are you and your spouse this year?
ask.why: Age decides when required withdrawals start, Medicare, and how long the plan runs; being married decides the tax brackets, and a widow or widower may have survivor benefits and a spouse's options on inherited accounts.
ask.if_skipped: I need at least approximate ages to run anything.

have_ready: Birth dates for both of you
Social Security statements from ssa.gov for both of you
The latest statement for every account (IRAs, 401(k)s, Roth IRAs, brokerage, savings), with what you paid (cost basis) for brokerage accounts
Paychecks or yearly wages, and any pension or annuity amounts
Your last two tax returns (they set Medicare premiums, and Form 8606 shows any after-tax IRA money)
Roughly what you spend in a year

answer.headline: Convert about $56,000 a year from Dana's IRA, 2026 through 2035.
answer.subline: By 2055 that leaves the family about $132,193 better off after taxes, in today's money, than not converting.

stay at or under IRMAA tier 1 each year for 2 years (2026–2027)
